_about: Recovered from C2A2_Explorer_Complete_User_Guide.pdf (117pp, captured 2026-07-26). Plates and captions are authoritative; reach-recipes are NOT yet present.

plates.title: Default view on load
plates.caption: The Explorer opens here, on Community Accelerator Tools > Sociogram — not on Start here. Row 1 holds the five chapters and the Record button; row 2 holds the sub-tools for the active chapter. Both rows persist throughout.

plates.title: Help overlay (?)
plates.caption: The '?' at the right of the sub-tab row opens a help overlay for the tool currently loaded. Every major tool has its own.

plates.title: Record — active state (staged)
plates.caption: STAGED: the Record button's active appearance, shown without starting a real capture. Record calls the browser screen-capture API, so the real state is an actual screen recording.

plates.title: Record — completion modal (staged)
plates.caption: STAGED: the 'Recording Complete' modal offering 'Save to Downloads', revealed from the page's own markup.

plates.title: On a phone
plates.caption: At 390 px the wordmark and Record button drop away and the chapter tabs scroll sideways. The Sociogram prints its own caveat: 'Mobile preview - pan and tap nodes - filters require a larger screen.'

plates.title: Start here on a phone
plates.caption: Reading pages adapt well to a narrow screen.

plates.title: Community Explorer on a phone
plates.caption: The graph tools remain usable for panning and tapping, without the filter rail.

plates.title: The whole route
plates.caption: The intended entry point: 'about thirty minutes, three stops'. Orient, Decode the names, Where's the beef. Each stop links out to a destination page reachable from nowhere else.

plates.title: Stop 1 — Orient
plates.caption: 'A first look at this system raises a fair question: is there really something here…' The page does not argue the point; it walks you to three places to judge directly.

plates.title: Stop 2 — Decode the names
plates.caption: Fifteen thinkers by last name, each with a one-line handle, because everything deeper refers to them that way. Links to the full Who's Who and to the Sociogram.

plates.title: Stop 3 — Where's the beef
plates.caption: Two free-form dives of about ten minutes each: the review cards, and one worked example.

plates.title: Fifteen angles — opening
plates.caption: Reached from 'See all 15 framings'. The page states that C2A2 resists a single description and offers a constellation of frameworks instead.

plates.title: Angle 01 — the MacIntyre framing
plates.caption: The page names this 'the telos that orders every other angle below': a concrete response to MacIntyre's Gifford Lectures call to reconceive the university so rival traditions can be made answerable to one another. If you read one angle, read this one.

plates.title: Further angles
plates.caption: Angle 02 gives the name itself — an accelerator/detector for traditions, with the accelerator bringing lineages into contact and the detector instrumenting the collision. The remaining angles continue down the page.

plates.title: The cast
plates.caption: Reached from 'See the full Who's Who'. Start here is explicit that this comes before the deeper material, since everything refers to these figures by last name alone.

plates.title: Continued
plates.caption: The remainder of the roster, including the companion traditions — Aquinas's Summa, MacIntyre, Rohr and Wright.

plates.section_title: START HERE > REVIEW LOG — THE EVIDENCE
plates.title: Historical preservation archive
plates.caption: Reached from 'Read the review cards' — the page Start here calls 'where's the beef'. 292 cards, 78 review dates, 12 decision emails, 511 PRS triples, 54 bridges, 54 findings, spanning to 2026-07-21. Five streams across the top, with Expand all / Collapse all.

plates.section_title: START HERE > REVIEW LOG — THE EVIDENCE
plates.title: Cards, chronological
plates.caption: Each card carries a proposal id, the tradition it belongs to, an APPROVED status and the source title. Grouped by review date.

plates.section_title: START HERE > REVIEW LOG — THE EVIDENCE
plates.title: Further into the stream
plates.caption: The archive continues at length; only the opening is shown here.

plates.section_title: START HERE > REVIEW LOG — THE EVIDENCE
plates.title: Your Responses
plates.caption: The decision responses, rendered verbatim from the original decision emails.

plates.section_title: START HERE > REVIEW LOG — THE EVIDENCE
plates.title: PRS Triples
plates.caption: 511 distinct triples across 15 traditions. The stream opens as one card per thinker with its own count — Levin 71, Carroll 54, McGilchrist 51, down to MacIntyre 5. Expand a thinker to list that tradition's triples.

plates.section_title: START HERE > REVIEW LOG — THE EVIDENCE
plates.title: PRS Triples — a single triple, opened
plates.caption: Clicking any triple opens it in a pop-up reader showing the full record: Label, Problem, Resource, Solution, date added, source and confidence, with the originating file named at the foot (here traditions/levin/prs_triplets.md). The header reads '1 / 511' — the reader is not scoped to the thinker you clicked.

plates.section_title: START HERE > REVIEW LOG — THE EVIDENCE
plates.title: PRS Triples — paging the full set
plates.caption: Prev and Next (or the left and right arrow keys) walk the entire set of 511 one at a time, across all fifteen traditions, without returning to the list. Close with the x.

plates.section_title: START HERE > REVIEW LOG — THE EVIDENCE
plates.title: Bridges
plates.caption: 54 records in the bridges stream.

plates.section_title: START HERE > REVIEW LOG — THE EVIDENCE
plates.title: Findings
plates.caption: 54 records in the findings stream, with a flag filter.

plates.section_title: START HERE > SUMMA COMMENTARY — THE WORKED EXAMPLE
plates.title: Contemporary parallels to Aquinas, day by day
plates.caption: Reached from 'Take one worked example'. Start here poses it as the answer to 'what can that mind do?'

plates.section_title: START HERE > SUMMA COMMENTARY — THE WORKED EXAMPLE
plates.title: Into the commentary
plates.caption: The day-by-day structure running from the Introduction through the Prima Pars.

plates.title: Graph view
plates.caption: Opens on the Graph sub-tab. Hold Forces, Show Names, Fit All, and a search field with Search / Clear.

plates.title: Graph — help overlay
plates.caption: The '?' beside Graph / Cards explains what the graph plots and how to read it.

plates.title: Graph — node selected
plates.caption: Clicking a node opens its detail panel. One representative selection.

plates.title: Graph — search results
plates.caption: A search filters the graph in place; Clear restores it.

plates.title: Cards view — controls
plates.caption: Free-text search across names, type and subtype labels, geography, verified hosts, narrative descriptions and all PRS fields, plus a plain-language ask. Counts: 1,006 communities, 11 types, 158 subtypes, 155 countries. Note the caveat on the right: every record is inferred seed until a community claims it.

plates.title: Cards — the directory
plates.caption: Below the filter panel sit the Cards / Map / PRS / Overview sub-views and the directory itself — the first 60 of 1,006. Each card shows type, geography, a P/R/S summary and a 'View G-P-R-S profile' link. These sub-views live in a nested frame and are invisible in a short window.

plates.title: Cards — Map
plates.caption: The same result set plotted geographically.

plates.title: Cards — PRS
plates.caption: The result set as Problem / Resource / Solution records.

plates.title: Cards — Overview
plates.caption: Aggregate view over the current result set.

plates.title: Contents
plates.caption: Opens on CONTENTS. The sidebar switches between CONTENTS, THINKERS and SOLVED; an 'Ask Claude' chat sits at the foot.

plates.title: Thinkers
plates.caption: A tab per thinker: Levin, Hoffman, Carroll, Hawkins, Wolfram, Friston, Fredrickson, Kastrup and Loughran.

plates.title: Thinker selected
plates.caption: One representative thinker.

plates.title: Solved
plates.caption: The SOLVED view.

plates.title: Solved — item selected
plates.caption: One representative solved item opened.

plates.title: Lower page
plates.caption: The document area below the first screen.

plates.title: Concepts (Student mode)
plates.caption: Opens in Student mode on Concepts: 75 concepts, 6 topic areas, 6 physicists. Cards carry a definition and, where one exists, a simulation link.

plates.title: Physicists
plates.caption: Newton, Maxwell, Boltzmann, Einstein, Feynman and Wolfram.

plates.title: Progress
plates.caption: The Progress sidebar.

plates.title: Instructor mode
plates.caption: The same material in Instructor mode.

plates.title: Full summary modal
plates.caption: 'Read full summary' opens a long-form summary. Note: it must be dismissed before the AI answer bar below is usable.

plates.title: AI — Explain differently
plates.caption: Returns a fresh explanation. Runs through the shared C2A2 pipeline, labelled 'no key needed'.

plates.title: AI — Give me a problem
plates.caption: Generates a practice problem with staged hints.

plates.title: AI — Find an analogy
plates.caption: Returns an analogy for the concept.

plates.title: AI — Simulate
plates.caption: The answer bar carries Explain, Problem, Analogy and Simulate, an 'Ask AI' toggle and Clear. The separate 'PhET Simulation' links on the concept cards leave the site for external hosts.

plates.title: Opening view
plates.caption: A SUMMA DAYS selector covering 192 days with ALL / NONE, plus Fit, Freeze and Labels.

plates.title: Selection made
plates.caption: Selecting a point opens the associated commentary.

plates.title: Labels toggled
plates.caption: Labels annotate the plotted points.

plates.title: Summa Days panel
plates.caption: The day selector expanded.

plates.title: Pulse
plates.caption: A five-step spine from raw sources to shared graph, each marked LIVE or PLANNED, above the monitored source lanes — 19 feeds across 7 lanes. Tabs: Pulse, History, My Lens, Roadmap.

plates.title: Pulse — lower area
plates.caption: Source monitoring and signal detail below the first screen.

plates.title: History
plates.caption: Past heartbeat snapshots.

plates.title: History — snapshot selected
plates.caption: One representative snapshot opened.

plates.title: My Lens
plates.caption: Local-autonomy controls: filter by source, hidden sources, hidden tags, keywords and minimum relevance; Rank & deliver sets boosted tags, sort and digest cadence. The consent checkboxes govern sharing and are unchecked by default; the lens is stored on your device.

plates.title: Roadmap
plates.caption: The planned stages of the heartbeat system.

plates.title: Default view
plates.caption: The wiki knowledge graph: 4,385 file nodes, 114,182 edges. Top strip: Hold, Names, Fit All, layout Mode, Score mode, Brightness, a Since slider and a settings gear. Left rail selects files; the Edges legend is top right; narration and search run along the foot.

plates.title: Left rail — traditions
plates.caption: The fifteen tradition filters, each with its own '?', above the Structure group.

plates.title: Left rail — continued
plates.caption: Further structure and content-tag filters.

plates.title: Left rail — foot
plates.caption: The end of the rail.

plates.title: Edge help
plates.caption: Explains the edge types — Wikilink, Mention, Reference — and whether an edge crosses or stays within a category.

plates.title: Content-tag help
plates.caption: Each group and tag carries its own '?' giving a definition in place.

plates.title: Settings dialog
plates.caption: Text-to-speech provider and voice (Browser, Kokoro or OpenAI) and the AI provider (C2A2 broker, Groq, Ollama or OpenAI direct). This is where you supply your own key once the free semantic queries run out.

plates.title: Search result
plates.caption: A plain search filters the graph immediately and costs nothing. The 'Ask AI' checkbox instead sends the query to a language model, against a limited free allowance.

plates.title: Node detail panel
plates.caption: Clicking a node opens the file in the right reading panel with its title and path.

plates.title: File reader — left panel
plates.caption: A second file opened alongside, so two can be read at once. Each panel has a dismiss and a pop-out control.

plates.title: Default view
plates.caption: The 3-D PRS connectome, with Reset View, a Labels toggle, and search with Clear / Reset.

plates.title: Filters — continued
plates.caption: The filter column below the first screen.

plates.title: Filters — foot
plates.caption: The remainder of the column.

plates.title: Filter help
plates.caption: What the filters select and how the layout is built.

plates.title: Legend help
plates.caption: The legend's own '?' defines the plotted categories.

plates.title: PRS detail panel
plates.caption: Selecting a point opens its PRS record.

plates.title: Schedule
plates.caption: Opens on Schedule, with Play, Pause, Reset, Narrate, a speed selector from 10x to 720x, skip and mute.

plates.title: Sociogram
plates.caption: The agents plotted as a sociogram.

plates.title: Explorer
plates.caption: A sortable table: sessions, events, eval+apply counts, E/A ratio, errors, tool coverage and last run, with a category filter.

plates.title: Agent detail drawer
plates.caption: Selecting a row opens the drawer, which can be dragged and resized.

plates.title: Narration running
plates.caption: Narrate plays the schedule back with spoken commentary.

plates.title: Raster (per-agent runs)
plates.caption: Three selectors drive it: view, metric (events, output tokens, total tokens, cache reads, thinking steps, duration and several yield measures) and colour (by category or cache-read share).

plates.title: Waveform (system pulse)
plates.caption: The same metric as a single system-wide pulse.

plates.title: Returned vs sent (tokens)
plates.caption: Tokens returned against tokens sent.

plates.title: Lower panel
plates.caption: The explanatory panel beneath the plot.

plates.title: Contents
plates.caption: The Summa Explorer. Left pane offers Contents and Sociogram, a 'Show article level' toggle and 'Collapse all'; the tree runs Part > Question > Article with live completion counts.

plates.title: Sociogram
plates.caption: The same corpus as a graph.

plates.title: Question expanded
plates.caption: Expanding a question reveals its articles.

plates.title: Article open — Transcript
plates.caption: Opening an article loads it in the reading pane. Transcript is the default; the mode row also offers Contemporary Synthesis and an Index return. That row stays hidden until an article is open.

plates.title: Article — Contemporary Synthesis
plates.caption: The same article in synthesis mode.

plates.title: Opening view
plates.caption: A single long reading page.

plates.title: Help overlay
plates.caption: '? What is this' explains what the page collects and how to read it.

plates.title: Reading — first section
plates.caption: Into the body of the study.

plates.title: Reading — middle
plates.caption: A representative section further down.

plates.title: Reading — later section
plates.caption: A later section; the page continues well beyond.

plates.title: Four-level scaffold, collapsed
plates.caption: Opens with all four interaction levels collapsed, above 'The Road Ahead'. The chapter carries its own note that this section is a scaffold under active development.

plates.title: Level One — Intrapersonal Integration
plates.caption: Marked UNDER CONSTRUCTION and deliberately inert: the header suppresses the click. Not a fault.

plates.title: Level Two — Small-Group Tradition
plates.caption: '…in working things out with others.' Expanded.

plates.title: Level Three — Inter-Tradition Dialogue
plates.caption: '…in richly-informed mutual exchange with others.'

plates.title: Level Four — Meta-Traditional Encounter
plates.caption: '…in pursuit of wisdom and the common good.'

plates.title: The level cards
plates.caption: Expanding the levels reveals the individual cards beneath them — eleven in total, two marked 'coming'.

plates.title: Level Two — the signal stream
plates.caption: The first of three interactives embedded in the level cards. Level Two's 'In practice' row carries a live signal stream (level2_signal_stream.html) showing builders becoming mutually informed.

plates.title: Level Three — the DET readout
plates.caption: The second: Level Three embeds a two-act walkthrough of the DET algorithm (intertradition-readout.html) — Act 1 prepares the pair, Act 2 interacts and reads the outcome. It has its own transport (Play, Prev, Next, Restart and a speed slider) stepping through 18 stages, each with a card and a physics analogue. A further row is marked MORE COMING — the program-timeline view of all 40 steps.

plates.title: Level Four — the 40-step matrix
plates.caption: The third: Level Four embeds the full DET 40-step structure matrix (intertradition-matrix.html), the complete method made visible.

plates.title: The Road Ahead
plates.caption: Expands to the 32 development pathways.

plates.title: The 32 pathways
plates.caption: Grouped as Infrastructure Spine, Core Interaction, Content Surfacing and Presentation. Each row carries a number, a status badge — DRAFTED or OUTLINED — and a one-line description. A star marks the ISME demo critical path for the 8-10 July 2026 presentation.

plates.title: Pathway reader
plates.caption: Clicking a pathway opens its full document in a reader, showing the status badges, the source path (here architecture/00_broker.md) and the complete text. One representative pathway.

plates.title: Pathway reader — Next Step
plates.caption: Prev and Next Step page through all 32 pathways without returning to the list.

plates.title: Lower page
plates.caption: The remainder of the chapter, below the pathway list.

_reach: reach drives the app to the plate. reach_exact=false means these steps reach the plate PAGE but not its exact state -- the within-page steps were lost with the capture harness and are deliberately not guessed. Every selector here is asserted against wiki/explorer.html and wiki/start_here.html by build_reach.py, which fails the run rather than writing a stale manifest.
